spec.agency.evidence: [沙王·codex] 图1及0–1.5秒：我面对右侧冲来的敌人，低伏并拢铲刃护住身前，已有戒备；敌人尚未贴身，暂不起手说得通。1.5–5.5秒：我横扫、尾刺、甲盖顶开敌人，挨打后甲壳震动并立即反击，没有站着等。5.5–6.3秒：我先横扫逼退敌人，再朝右扎地、沿直线突进，以图2所示四根尖刺发动攻击，随后在最右端钻出，行动目的连贯。6.3–10秒：我转身确认身后的树尸，再收拢铲刃保持警戒，符合战斗结束后的反应。；[树人·claude] As a treant my moves make sense beat by beat. Spec 0–1.5 s and image 1 (opening frame): all three of us charge left at the sand king with our branch arms raised and roots kicking up mud. We are actively attacking, not standing around. 1.5–5.5 s: we keep striking it from right in front of it and fight the whole time. When the shovel blade hits me, my bark splits and I stagger back, so I react to the hit. 5.5 s: its sweep forces us back. 5.8–6.1 s: the spikes throwing us into the air are written as a control, and image 2 (peak frame) shows all three of us upright in mid-air above the spike tips, not tumbling, in a controlled pose. 6.3 s onward: we die on landing, so we have no further agency. Minor flaw: the opening frame lines us up in single file and the 1.5–5.5 s beat says we take turns striking, so we lean a little toward queuing up. But the script says all three of us keep attacking and we do not stand still, so it holds up.

spec.gaze.evidence: [沙王·codex] 规格“视线”逐拍覆盖了我的朝向：0–1.5秒头和铲刃朝冲来的树人；1.5–5.5秒头随出手方向转，持续盯住正在扑打我的敌人；5.5–6.3秒明确扎地、地下穿行的特殊状态，钻出时头朝右方前进方向；6.3–8.5秒转身看树尸；8.5–10秒持续看着三具树尸。地下突进期间无法保持地表目视有明确情境依据，全片另明确禁止看镜头、看天，没有遗漏我的视线安排。；[树人·claude] The spec writes a gaze for my every beat: 0–1.5 s our faces and eye sockets point left at it; 1.5–5.5 s we watch it; when thrown we are a controlled exception; after death gaze no longer counts. The writing is complete. But in image 1 (opening frame) the faces of the three treants, especially the middle one and the rightmost one, show both dark eye sockets at once. The face is frontal or three-quarter toward the camera, not in left-facing profile, which contradicts 'faces and eye sockets toward screen left, watching it' and 'nobody looks at the camera'. Only the arm direction points left. Since the first frame sets the gaze for the 0–1.5 s beat, the model is very likely to keep the faces pointed at the camera. I can't be sure at this resolution how far the faces are turned, so this is a fail. In image 2 the faces of the treants in mid-air are also roughly toward the camera, but that falls under the controlled exception and is not counted.

spec.status_visual.evidence: [fidelity·claude] Burrowstrike stuns its targets, and in the original the stun marker is a pale blue-white swirl over the head. The spec contradicts itself here. Also, the treants die on landing, so it's unclear when the stun should show (airborne vs. after landing). The spec needs to state this explicitly.

spec.agency.evidence: [沙王·codex] 图1及0–1.5秒：我面对右侧来敌低伏、并拢铲刃护住身前，已经戒备；暂不起手符合尚未接敌的阶段。1.5–5.5秒：我横扫、尾刺、甲盖顶开敌人，挨打后立即反击，没有站着等。5.5–6.3秒：我先横扫逼退，再朝右扎地、直线穿行发动尖刺并迅速钻出，攻击衔接合理；图2对应我在地下发动技能的峰值。6.3–8.5秒：我转身确认身后树尸；8.5–10秒：我收拢铲刃、保持尾针高翘，进入稳定收势。；[树人·claude] From the treant's side: in image 1 (frame 1, 0s) all three of us are in one line in the middle of the frame. We stride left toward the scorpion-like creature on the left third of the frame, with branch arms raised and lumps of mud kicked up under our root feet. We are clearly charging at full speed and have not frozen in place. The script for 1.5–5.5s has us take turns lashing it and stagger back when the blades hit, so our reactions make sense. Being launched by the spikes at 5.8–6.1s is a written control effect. In image 2 (around 6s) all three of us are in mid-air above the spike tips, already off the points, upright and not tumbling, which matches 'controlled'. Dying on landing at 6.3–8.5s is the user's chosen death and is not standing still waiting to be hit. Our motive at every beat (charge, fight back, get controlled, die) holds up.

spec.gaze.evidence: [沙王·codex] 0–1.5秒明确我的头和铲刃朝右对准来敌，与图1一致；1.5–5.5秒明确我始终盯住正在扑打自己的树人，头随攻击方向转动；5.5–6.3秒明确扎地、地下穿行及朝右钻出的朝向，地下阶段属于无法持续目视敌人的动作情境，图2中我未露出地面；6.3–8.5秒明确我转身看树尸；8.5–10秒明确我持续看着三具树尸。各拍均有视线或动作朝向交代，并明确全片不看镜头、不看天。；[树人·claude] The spec requires that at 0–1.5s 'the faces and eye sockets of the three treants all stare toward the left of the frame at it', and that 'no one looks at the camera at any point'. In image 1 our legs and bodies stride left, but the heads of all three (first at about x≈690, y≈555; second at about x≈880, y≈560; third at about x≈1135, y≈560) show two dark eye sockets side by side, facing forward. That reads as a face turned toward the camera, not a side profile looking left at the scorpion. In image 2 (around 6s, while airborne) the middle treant's face (about x≈925, y≈300) also faces the camera head-on. Being launched is a written control exception, but looking at the camera is still forbidden. Our faces are small, so I can't be fully sure, but I can't confirm we are looking at the enemy and not the camera. Judged fail.

spec.status_visual.evidence: [fidelity·claude] 原版 Burrowstrike 命中后会把单位抛起并眩晕，眩晕标记是 ThunderclapTarget，也就是头顶一圈浅蓝白旋涡（follow-up 137）。规格却在光线段写了「本条树人落地即死，没有眩晕标记」，还把「眩晕光圈，头顶旋涡」写进了负面词，这直接违反「原版标记不能出现在负面词里」。图4 峰值图约 6 秒那一瞬，三个树人在刺尖上方半空、还没死，正是原版里应该已经挂上眩晕旋涡的时刻，可三个树人头顶都没有任何浅蓝白旋涡。规格注明这是 follow-up 301 的用户改法；但附图里没有原版 Burrowstrike 截图，所以既无法确认原版里被抛起的单位头顶是否先出现旋涡，也无法确认这个改法能否豁免本项。拿不准，判 fail，需要用户确认 301 的豁免是否覆盖 6 秒时树人在空中这一拍。
